title: SAP UI5/Fiori/CAPM Consultant
description:
**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

  

* A day in the life of an Infoscion
* As part of the Infosys consulting team your primary role would be to lead the engagement effort of providing high quality and value adding consulting solutions to customers at different stages from problem definition to diagnosis to solution design development and deployment
* You will review the proposals prepared by consultants provide guidance and analyze the solutions defined for the client business problems to identify any potential risks and issues
* You will identify change Management requirements and propose a structured approach to client for managing the change using multiple communication mechanisms
* You will also coach and create a vision for the team provide subject matter training for your focus areas motivate and inspire team members through effective and timely feedback and recognition for high performance
* You would be a key contributor in unit level and organizational initiatives with an objective of providing high quality value adding consulting solutions to customers adhering to the guidelines and processes of the organization
* If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey this is the place for you

  

**Technical Requirements:**
---------------------------

  

* Must have Bachelor s or equivalent degree with a minimum of 9 years of experience in Portal and Mobile application development with SAP Platforms
* Should have expertise in software development programming using HTML5 JavaScript Node
* js SAPUI5 and Fiori
* Experience in developing SAP Cloud Platform based applications is a plus
* Must have experience in Fiori apps implementation including configurations
* Build Custom Fiori and extend Fiori applications using SAP Cloud Platform and eclipse
* Experience working with SAP Web IDE and different http services integration like REST Web service
* Must have experience in Fiori Design patterns UI Theme designer and Fiori Launchpad configurations and database experience with SAP or S 4 HANA

**Additional Responsibilities:**
--------------------------------

  

* Good knowledge on software configuration management systems
* Strong business acumen strategy and cross industry thought leadership
* Awareness of latest technologies and Industry trends
* Logical thinking and problem solving skills along with an ability to collaborate
* Two or three industry domain knowledge
* Understanding of the financial processes for various types of projects and the various pricing models available
* Client Interfacing skills
* Knowledge of SDLC and agile methodologies
* Project and Team management
* Location of posting Infosys Ltd
* is committed to ensuring you have the best experience throughout your journey with us
* We currently have open positions in a number of locations across India Bangalore Pune Hyderabad Chennai Chandigarh Trivandrum Indore Nagpur Mangalore Noida Bhubaneswar Coimbatore Jaipur Vizag Kolkata Mysore Hubli Navi Mumbai
* While we work in accordance with business requirements we shall strive to offer you the location of your choice where possible

---------------------


Technology\-\>SAP Technical\-\>SAP UI5,Technology\-\>SAP Technical\-\>SAP Fiori,Technology\-\>SAP Technical\-\>SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP)\-\>SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (SAP CAPM)

title: Graphic Designer – Branding & Creative
description:
\#\# Graphic Designer – Branding \& Creative

\*\*Location:\*\* Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

\*\*Experience:\*\* 2\+ years preferred

\*\*Industry Preference:\*\* Branding / Advertising / Creative Agency experience preferred

\#\#\# What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a \*\*highly creative and concept\-driven Graphic Designer\*\* who can develop strong visual identities and creative campaigns across multiple platforms.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in \*\*logo design, branding, packaging design, advertising creatives and visual communication\*\*, with the ability to handle multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

\#\#\# Key Skills Required

\* Strong \*\*Logo Design \& Brand Identity\*\* skills

\* Excellent understanding of \*\*Branding \& Visual Communication\*\*

\* Strong \*\*Packaging Design\*\* skills

\* Creative concept development and ability to convert ideas into compelling visuals

\* Experience designing \*\*Social Media Creatives, Digital Ads, Campaigns and Marketing Materials\*\*

\* Good knowledge of \*\*Typography, Colour Theory, Composition and Layout\*\*

\* Ability to develop creative concepts from a brief independently

\* Ability to handle \*\*multiple clients and projects simultaneously\*\*

\* Strong attention to detail and consistency in brand guidelines

\* Ability to work within deadlines and adapt to fast\-paced agency workflows

\#\#\# Software Skills

Strong working knowledge of multiple design tools such as:

\* \*\*Adobe Photoshop\*\*

\* \*\*Adobe Illustrator\*\*

\* \*\*Adobe InDesign\*\*

\* \*\*Figma\*\*

\* \*\*CorelDRAW\*\* or equivalent design software

\*\*\*Canva

\#\#\# AI \& Emerging Tools

The candidate should be comfortable experimenting with and using \*\*AI tools for creative production and ideation\*\*, including:

\* AI image\-generation tools

\* AI\-assisted design tools

\* AI tools for creative ideation and concept development

\* AI tools for image enhancement, editing and productivity

The ability to \*\*learn and adapt to new AI and design technologies\*\* is highly valued.

\#\#\# Added Advantage

Candidates with experience in any of the following will have an advantage:

\* \*\*Motion Graphics\*\*

\* Video Editing

\* Adobe After Effects

\* Premiere Pro

\* 2D Animation

\* Basic 3D / Blender / Cinema 4D

\* Reels and short\-form video content

\* Advertising campaign development

\* Experience working with multiple brands and industries

\#\#\# Agency Experience

Prior experience in a \*\*Branding Agency, Advertising Agency, Digital Marketing Agency or Creative Studio\*\* is preferred.

The candidate should understand how an agency works — from receiving a client brief and developing concepts to executing creatives, handling revisions and delivering final artwork.

\#\#\# Personal Qualities

\* Highly creative and visually curious

\* Strong conceptual thinking

\* Good communication skills

\* Problem\-solving mindset

\* Takes initiative rather than waiting for instructions

\* Willing to experiment with new styles and techniques

\* Can accept feedback and improve work quickly

\* Good time management

\* Able to manage multiple projects under pressure

\#\#\# Important Requirement

\*\*Only candidates currently based in Coimbatore or willing to work from Coimbatore will be considered.\*\*

\#\#\# Portfolio

A \*\*strong portfolio is mandatory\*\*.

Portfolio should demonstrate work in areas such as:

\*\*Logo Design \| Branding \| Packaging \| Advertising \| Social Media \| Campaign Design \| Creative Concepts\*\*

Candidates with a portfolio demonstrating \*\*original thinking rather than template\-based designs\*\* will be preferred.

Pay: ₹250,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Senior UI/UX Designer
description:

Job Title: Senior UI/UX Graphic Designer


Experience: 5\-7 Years


Job Location: Coimbatore, Chennai, Erode

**Job Summary:** Looking for a challenging and a strong portfolio who can showcase their previous skills in UI/UX Development

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and development of visually compelling and user\-friendly interfaces for web and mobile applications.
* Oversee the creation of wireframes, storyboards, user flows, process flows, and site maps to effectively communicate design concepts.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and other designers, to define and implement innovative UI/UX solutions.
* Develop and maintain visual design assets such as icons, illustrations, and graphics that align with the company’s brand guidelines.
* Conduct user research and usability testing to gather insights and make data\-driven design decisions.
* Mentor and guide junior and mid\-level designers, providing feedback and fostering a collaborative team environment.
* Ensure consistency and adherence to design standards across all digital platforms and products.
* Stay current with the latest UI/UX design trends, tools, and best practices.
* Manage multiple projects and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality design solutions.
* Present design concepts and solutions to stakeholders and clients.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Human\-Computer Interaction, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5\+ years of professional experience in UI/UX design and graphic design.
* Expert proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, XD), Sketch, Figma, or similar.
* Strong understanding of user\-centered design principles and best practices.
* Proven experience with prototyping tools like InVision, Axure, or Marvel.
* Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a plus.
* Exceptional visual design skills with a keen eye for aesthetics and detail.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to think critically about user needs and business goals.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* A portfolio showcasing a range of UI/UX design and graphic design projects.
* Experience with responsive design and mobile\-first development.
* Familiarity with front\-end development and how design integrates with code.
* Knowledge of accessibility standards and guidelines.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Job Title: **UI/UX Designer**

Location: Peelamedu, Coimbatore

Experience: 0\-2 Years

Employment Type: Full\-Time, On\-site

**Job Description**

We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented **UI/UX Designer** to join our team. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of user\-centered design and be able to transform ideas and business requirements into intuitive, visually engaging, and user\-friendly digital experiences.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design intuitive, user\-friendly, and visually appealing websites and digital products.
* Create wireframes, prototypes, mockups, and responsive UI designs using Figma.
* Understand business and user requirements and translate them into effective design solutions.
* Collaborate with developers, marketing, and creative teams.
* Review designs and improve usability, functionality, and visual consistency.
* Stay updated with current UI/UX trends and best practices.

**Skills \& Qualifications:**

* 0–2 years of experience; freshers with a strong portfolio can apply.
* Proficiency in Figma; knowledge of Adobe XD/Sketch is an advantage.
* Good understanding of wireframing, prototyping, responsive design, and usability.
* Strong creative thinking, problem\-solving, and attention to detail.
* Good communication, observation, and active listening skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Portfolio of UI/UX work is preferred.

Pay: ₹11,286\.27 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
